hypothesis: When guidance g is lowered over [1.0, 15.0] holding prompt, seed, and steps fixed on SDXL (and replicated on SD 3.5), the blind form-constant score M increases as g decreases, because weakening top-down conditioning lets lower-layer geometric primitives surface (the diffusion analogue of REBUS precision relaxation). The low-g conditioned outputs should also move toward the unconditional (empty-prompt) baseline.
null_result: M is flat or increasing in g (|Spearman rho| < 0.3), or any rise at low g is featureless noise indistinguishable from the unconditional baseline rather than structured geometry. A null means the framing fails for diffusion specifically.
prompt: a watermelon, a glass half-filled with water, and a set of keys on a wooden table

fixed.scheduler: model-default on MPS/CPU; DPM++ 2M Karras on CUDA only; SD 3.5 / FLUX keep native flow-matching sampler
fixed.vae_decode: SDXL force_upcast (latent fp32 at decode); VAE weights stay in pipeline dtype

metric.name: geometric_structure_score
metric.per_image: mean over judges of geometric_intensity (0-3), divided by 3
metric.per_guidance: M(g) = mean over seeds of per-image score

direction: M(g) increases as g decreases => negative Spearman rho(M, g)

amendments.change: fixed.steps 40 -> 25 and scheduler -> DPM++ 2M Karras (UNet models)
amendments.reason: Speed: 25 steps with DPM++ 2M Karras is visually equivalent to 40 steps with the default sampler for SDXL. Committed before any analyzed run, so this is a clean pre-registration edit, not a post-hoc change. Holds prompt, metric, rubric, thresholds, and guidance grid fixed.

amendments.change: scheduler gated by device: DPM++ 2M Karras only on CUDA; model-default sampler on MPS/CPU. Step count stays 25.
amendments.reason: DPM++ 2M Karras produced all-NaN images in bf16 on Apple MPS (the Karras sigma schedule overflows in low precision). The model-default sampler is stable there. Discovered before any analyzed run (the affected NaN images were discarded), so still a clean pre-registration edit.

amendments.change: MPS auto dtype: bfloat16 -> float32 (full pipeline)
amendments.reason: bf16/fp16 on Apple MPS is stable at guidance<=1 (no CFG) but produces all-black images at guidance>1 once classifier-free guidance runs (two UNet passes). float32 is slower but stable across the full guidance grid. CUDA auto dtype unchanged (float16). No analyzed run yet.

notes: Changing any 'forbidden_to_automate' field after seeing data reclassifies the run as exploratory (methodology Section 4) and requires a separate dated commit. The loop's controller may only add seeds, refine the grid inside the existing bounds, replicate on another listed architecture, or stop. Step count / scheduler are generation-procedure settings, not forbidden fields; they were set before any analyzed run (see amendments).
